name: @lagrange/api-server
description: Lagrange Station API server (Rust Axum). The npm workspace owns the OpenAPI contract: openapi.json is the versioned spec generated from scripts/openapi-spec.mjs, linted by openapi:check, and consumed as TypeScript types by apps/web.

scripts.typecheck: node -e "console.log('@lagrange/api-server typecheck: TS types are checked by openapi:check')"
scripts.test: node -e "console.log('@lagrange/api-server test: contract tests run via cargo test -p api-server')"
